summary: Confirmed a real Research input-delivery defect. Diagnostic treatment restores complete structural file bytes, but no completed A/B behavior analysis, held-out improvement, cost saving, or cross-game transfer was established. Stop and retain evidence; do not land a production optimization.
observations: Actual ReferenceResearchAgent → CodexAccountProvider → CodexCliProvider calls used the frozen production component, not a main-chat substitute. Input assembly replayed the existing factory context compiler from a historical migration seed; this was not a full factory.run/resume execution.
The source frame index contains 111916 characters / 111924 bytes; the A sandbox file is empty. The provenance manifest is truncated to invalid JSON.

A2 actual Research issued repeated reads and its item_6 command failed parsing the truncated provenance manifest. This establishes an execution consequence of delivery loss, not the historical gameplay root cause.

B1 only materialized the same two schema-valid prerequisite JSON files in the existing sandbox and updated their existing hash records. Prompt, output schema, model and the 76 selected media files were unchanged. Both files then preserved original hashes and parsed successfully in local verification; B read their content, but did not complete Research.

Both A1/A2 reached the 180-second timeout. Network reconnects occurred before tool execution. B1 was manually terminated after budget overrun was discovered, so timing/quality comparisons are censored.

Declared reasoning was max; actual CLI session context was ultra for all three runs. No model or reasoning change was made in A/B. This is a frozen-configuration discrepancy, not a proven performance cause.

nextExperimentPrerequisites: Resolve live budget accounting before another model trial: count per-request cumulative usage, cached input and timeout/abort usage; validate stopping with a local stub before spending again.
Pin effective CLI settings and tool availability, rather than treating the declared model-policy file as proof.

Before another paid validation, define a bounded evidence task and establish an eligible held-out sample; do not ask the user to become daily QA.
